description: This file defines a template class WebSocketClientImpl that manages WebSocket client connections, message handling, and connection events, customized with different encryption strategies. It interfaces with an AudioPlayer to push received data and handles connection lifecycle events.

classes.name: WebSocketClientImpl
classes.description: A templated C++ class implementing a WebSocket client that manages connection, message handling, and disconnection, supporting encryption strategies, and integrating with an AudioPlayer.

methods.name: WebSocketClientImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebSocket client and binds message handler.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified URI after removing protocol and ensuring port number.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages by passing them as data to the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: onServiceConnection
methods.description: Handles the result of a connection attempt, updating connection status and notifying the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: onServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, updating status and notifying the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: removeProtocol
methods.description: Removes the protocol prefix from a URI string.

methods.name: ensureAddressHasPortNumber
methods.description: Ensures that the address string contains a port number, adding a default if missing.
